item.title: Esther 9, Victory and Celebration, God Turns Sorrow Into Joy
item.description: In Esther 9, God turns sorrow into joy as He delivers His people and establishes Purim. This episode highlights God’s providence and Christ’s victory.

item.title: The Battle for the Bible and the Call to Discernment
item.description: As we conclude our December series on the 2025 State of Theology, Dave Jenkins addresses growing doctrinal confusion and explains why the deeper crisis is ultimately about the authority of God’s Word. This episode calls Christians to trained biblical discernment and offers practical ways to stand firm with clarity and conviction as we head into 2026.
